# Billing and plans

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## What each plan includes

- **What it is:** The five plans (Bulk Message, Work, Growth, Pro, Agency), priced by contacts, not by messages.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** The owner chooses and changes the plan.
- **Where:** Settings > Billing
- **The agent can:** read the current plan and its features with `get_account` or `get_setup_status`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/plans-bulk-message-pro-agency.md, section "what-each-plan-includes". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/plans-bulk-message-pro-agency#what-each-plan-includes

## Subscribe or change the plan

- **What it is:** Subscribe, upgrade at once, or schedule a downgrade for the end of the period.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** The owner only. Admins can read it.
- **Where:** Settings > Billing > Update plan
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/billing.md, section "change-your-plan". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/billing#change-your-plan

## Usage, the card and payment details

- **What it is:** Plan & Usage shows the plan, contacts this month, seats, numbers and the billing period; Manage billing opens the card and payment details.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** The owner only. Admins can read it.
- **Where:** Settings > Billing > Manage billing
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/billing.md, section "manage-billing". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/billing#manage-billing

## Seats and removing an empty seat

- **What it is:** The owner's seat is free and each teammate is a paid seat; removing a teammate leaves an empty seat until the owner removes it.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins invite. Only the owner removes an empty seat.
- **Where:** Settings > Billing > Seats > Remove empty seat
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-seats.md, section "remove-an-empty-seat". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-seats#remove-an-empty-seat

## Pay for numbers over the plan

- **What it is:** A number above the plan's allowance shows Over plan: it receives but sends nothing until it is added to the plan.
- **Plan:** Bulk Message, Work, Growth and Pro. A number over the plan receives messages but sends nothing until it is added. Agency sells no extra numbers.
- **Who can do it:** The owner. Admins and members see that the owner can add it.
- **Where:** Settings > Channels > Add to plan
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers.md, section "numbers-over-your-plan". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers#numbers-over-your-plan

## The trial and the Free plan

- **What it is:** The trial with no card, the card trials, and the Free plan after the trial.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** The owner chooses a plan or switches to Free.
- **Where:** Settings > Billing
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/plans.md, section "trials-and-free-plans". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/plans#trials-and-free-plans
